answer: Each submission needs cosignature from 2 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 38 submissions per epoch. Cosignatures are collected in beacon, verified in crystal, and terrace names every witness. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, which means paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. A 432 account operation therefore ties up 30 million dollars of idle capital. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
